proposed_widenings.name: WeaponFilter.this_weapon
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive magic-item family and rarity-scaled numeric bonus atoms already exist, but the surface cannot scope attack-roll and damage-roll bonuses to the enchanted weapon itself. Current filters only support coarse melee/ranged categories or broad wielding predicates, which would overgrant the bonus.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You have a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity."

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_weapon_1_2_or_3.dhall because any currently valid encoding would misrepresent the rule as applying to attacks or damage beyond this specific magic weapon.
